data.body:
Completion verification FAILED on one criterion, correctly. AC8 read 'with no sandbox mechanism available the run ABORTS non-zero' with no qualification, while AC13 says a CI runner proceeds UNSANDBOXED with a warning. The two contradicted each other, and the verifier quoted an earlier comment of mine on this ticket that had already noticed the discrepancy and never acted on it.

AC8 now reads: on a WORKSTATION with no mechanism the run aborts non-zero naming REBAR_MUTATION_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED; the CI-runner exception is the criterion below, and the two are exhaustive. That matches wrap() at scripts/mutation_sandbox.py: the CI branch waives with a WARNING, every other path raises SandboxUnavailable. No code changed — the criterion was wrong, not the implementation.
